name: Utilify
description: 63+ free, private, offline-first client-side web utilities for developers, creators, and professionals. All operations execute 100% in local browser memory with zero server uploads.

entries.name: Merge PDF
entries.description: Combine multiple PDF files client-side into a single document without server uploads.

entries.name: Compress PDF
entries.description: Compress PDF documents in local browser memory with high visual quality preservation.

entries.name: Image to PDF
entries.description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images to a single PDF document client-side.

entries.name: JPG to PDF
entries.description: Convert JPG photos directly into a paginated PDF document offline in browser memory.

entries.name: PDF to Image
entries.description: Extract and render all pages of a PDF document into JPG or PNG image files.

entries.name: PDF to JPG
entries.description: Convert PDF documents to high-resolution JPG images client-side without cloud uploads.

entries.name: Split PDF
entries.description: Extract custom page ranges or separate individual PDF pages client-side.

entries.name: Rotate PDF
entries.description: Rotate PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees clockwise or counterclockwise client-side.

entries.name: Protect PDF
entries.description: Encrypt PDF documents with custom passwords locally in browser memory.

entries.name: Unlock PDF
entries.description: Remove passwords and security restrictions from encrypted PDF documents.

entries.name: Remove PDF Pages
entries.description: Delete unwanted pages or custom page ranges from any PDF document client-side.

entries.name: Sign PDF
entries.description: Create digital signatures and stamp them onto PDF documents client-side securely.

entries.name: Image Compressor
entries.description: Optimize and compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images client-side directly in browser memory.

entries.name: Image Resizer
entries.description: Scale and resize image dimensions to custom pixels or percentages with aspect ratio lock.

entries.name: Image Cropper
entries.description: Crop images with interactive visual controls, aspect ratios, and instant export.

entries.name: Image Format Converter
entries.description: Convert between PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, and BMP formats locally in browser canvas.

entries.name: JSON Prettifier & Validator
entries.description: Prettify, format, validate, and minify JSON data structures client-side.

entries.name: Social Text Formatter
entries.description: Convert plain text to Unicode bold, italic, and cursive for LinkedIn, X, and Instagram.

entries.name: Word Counter & Readability Analyzer
entries.description: Calculate word counts, character metrics, reading time, and Flesch readability scores.

entries.name: Custom QR Code Generator
entries.description: Generate high-resolution vector and PNG QR codes with custom error correction.

entries.name: Text Diff Checker
entries.description: Side-by-side text and code comparison highlighting word and line changes.

entries.name: Cryptographic Hash Generator
entries.description: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 checksums using Web Crypto API.
